name: Winmate M101S-EX
summary: The Winmate M101S-EX is the hazardous-area version of a Winmate rugged 10.1-inch tablet, certified for Zone 2 under IECEx. Winmate also states ATEX certification, but the certificate isn't published. It is an intrinsically safe (Ex ic) design running Windows 10 IoT Enterprise.

otherSchemes: KCs Ex ic IIC T4 Gc

atex.marking: II 3G Ex ic IIC T4 Gc
atex.status: IECEx Current, issue 3, checked 2026-10-25; ATEX number not published

certification.northAmerica: Class I, Division 2, Groups A, B, C, D, T4A (datasheet)

safety.conditions: Charge only in the non-hazardous area with the adapter or cradle supplied by the manufacturer. Protect from liquid and dust contamination (pollution degree 2 or better). Connecting or disconnecting external ports, opening the enclosure or replacing the battery pack is permitted only when the explosive atmosphere is shown to be absent. Periodically inspect the interior where condensation can occur. Charging via the supplied adapter (19 V) and cradle (max 4.0 A) outside hazardous locations. Main battery pack BS101 is user-replaceable.
safety.peripherals: External ports and battery operations only when the atmosphere is shown to be absent (certificate).
safety.certifiedAccessories: Certificate names only the manufacturer battery pack BS101, supplied adapter and cradle. Datasheet lists desk dock, vehicle dock, vehicle cradle, vehicle charger, battery charger, hand strap, shoulder strap, carry bag, VESA kit without Ex marking.
